summary: This is a routine Form 6-K by Mesoblast Limited, a foreign private issuer, reporting its FY2026 financial results and operational update via an Australian Securities Exchange press release and investor presentation. The filing describes revenue growth, product launch progress, clinical trial milestones, and a credit facility, but contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, spin-off, or going-private transaction. It is an ordinary earnings/operational update with no M&A activity, deal terms, or corporate restructuring. The registrant is filing as the issuer of the report, and no special-situation categorization applies.
